Marta: Quick sync — RFC follow-up: propose a tiny service "compat-curator" to hold deprecation metadata (id, sunset, replacement, tenant exceptions) and broadcast invalidation to gateways. Thoughts?

Oliver: Strong +1 for single source. Concern: runtime dependency. Gateways must cache locally and subscribe to webhooks, not call curator per request.

Priya: We should surface deprecation as a response header: X-Compat-Dep: id:sunset:replacement. Also list in Console and expose tenant-level opt-out flags.

Sam: Soft-deprecate first. Gateways emit header, optionally auto-translate to replacement for a configurable grace window. Avoid hard 410 until telemetry shows low usage.

Marta: Rollout sketch: v0 curator API + schema -> adapter in eng-platform -> small tenant canary (header only) -> enable auto-translate for 50% -> ramp -> hard tombstone after >95% migrated.

Oliver: Tests: stale client -> header present, adapter translate behaviour, metrics emitted (per-tenant). I'll add test tickets.

deploy-bot: compat-curator v0.1 canary scheduled 2024-11-02T03:00:00Z. Monitor curator.deprecations.emitted.

Priya: Reminder: no query-param opt-outs (CDN cache leakage). Use header or tenant flag.

Marta: OK— arch owns schema, eng-platform adapters, eng-infra CDN invalidation, support handles tenant extensions. I'll open PR with appendix.
